idle_ttl_secs.description: An agent unused this long is unloaded (its session stays open).

memory_high_bytes.description:
Above this resident memory the least recently used agents are
unloaded; `0` is half the physical memory.

api_max_retries.description: Attempts per model call before the fallback chain is consulted.

auto_recovery_cycles.description:
Extra wait-and-retry cycles after retries and fallbacks are spent on
a transient failure with nothing streamed; `0` disables.

clarify_timeout_secs.description: How long the `clarify` tool waits for an answer.

intent_continuation.description:
Nudge a model that announces an action without calling a tool:
`"auto"` (Responses-wire models only), `true`, `false` or a list of
model-name substrings.

max_iterations.description: Maximum model calls per turn; `0` means unlimited.

max_verify_nudges.description:
Most consecutive verification nudges (`pre_verify` hook
continuations) in one turn; after that the turn finishes.

personalities.description: Custom or overriding personalities: name to prompt text.

personality.description:
Selected personality overlay (`none`, a built-in name or a key of
`[agent.personalities]`).

reasoning_overrides.description:
Per-model reasoning overrides: model id to a level or a tier name of
`[agent.reasoning_tiers]`.

reasoning_tiers.description:
Provider-specific tier names mapped to a level, for example
`ultra = "max"`.

run_budget_secs.description: Optional per-turn wall-clock budget; unset means no budget.

tool_concurrency.description: Tool calls of one batch that may run at once.

key_secret.description: Name of the secret this alias uses instead of the provider's.

oneOf.description: An auxiliary model pre-screens; uncertain calls are asked.
No prompts (deny rules and hardline blocks still apply).

cron_mode.description: Decision for approvals in cron jobs.

denial_breaker_threshold.description:
In `smart` mode, after this many consecutive denials by the
approval guardian the denial tells the model to stop trying
variations (`0` disables); a human approval resets the count.

deny.description: Command patterns that are always blocked.

single_query_mode.description: Decision for approvals in single-query (`-q`) runs.

timeout_secs.description: Unanswered approvals are denied after this long.

unattended_mode.description: Decision for approvals in other unattended sessions.

adopt_external_logins.description:
Use an existing Claude Code or Codex CLI sign-in when the profile
holds no credential of its own.

AutoResume.description: What a TUI opens when nothing names a session.

oneOf.description: The session last used in the TUI from this directory.

AuxiliaryConfig.description: The `[auxiliary]` section: one optional table per auxiliary task.

goal_judge.description: Goal judging (defaults to the main model).

side_question.description: Side questions (defaults to the main model).

transient_retries.description: Same-route retries of a retryable auxiliary failure.

voice_chat.description: Voice chat (defaults to the main model).

provider.description: Provider id; unset means `auto` (the session's main route).

timeout_secs.description:
Timeout; unset uses the task default (120 s for `vision` and
`compression`, 30 s for `approval` and `title`, 600 s for `curator`
and `evolution`).

BackgroundMode.description: When top-level spawns run in the background.

oneOf.description: Where the session can receive later completions.
Never: every call waits for its children.
Results and errors, one line each.

delay_ms.description:
Text from the same sender within this many milliseconds joins the
pending input.

split_delay_ms.description:
The wait after a part that filled the platform's limit (the client
probably split a longer message); at least `delay_ms`.

auto_local_for_private_urls.description:
With a cloud provider, private and LAN URLs open in a local sidecar
browser instead of being refused or sent to the provider.

chromium_args.description:
Extra local browser arguments; ones that disable the Chromium
sandbox or web security need the matching
`security.sandbox.allow_degraded` entry.

dialog_timeout_secs.description: Unanswered dialogs are dismissed after this long.

executable_path.description:
The local browser executable; empty uses the managed `chromium`
runtime, then a Chromium-family browser of the host.

headed.description:
Open a visible window (headless with a notice without a display);
kept between turns, idle reaping still applies.

inactivity_timeout_secs.description: Idle browser sessions are closed after this long.

launch_timeout_secs.description: Bound on a local browser start.

provider.description: Browser provider: `local` or a cloud browser plugin.

real_profile_autoclose.description:
The agent may offer `prometheus browser close-profile` (run only
after approval) when the real browser holds the profile.

real_profile_pin.description:
The real profile directory to copy (`Default`, `Profile 2`...);
empty uses the browser's last used profile.

use_real_profile.description:
Browse on a snapshot of the user's real browser profile (needs the
`browser.real_profile` grant).

user_data_dir.description:
A persistent local profile directory (relative paths resolve under
the profile); empty launches on a throwaway profile.

BudgetsConfig.description:
The `[budgets]` section. Every limit defaults to `0` (off) except
`unattended_root_usd`.

allow_unpriced.description:
Allow models without a known price under a USD budget (token
budgets still apply).

unattended_root_usd.description:
USD per root lineage of cron, unattended gateway sessions,
background delegations and harness evolution.

warn_ratio.description: Fraction of a limit at which a budget warning is emitted.

input_mode.description:
What plain text typed while a turn runs does: `queue` runs it as
the next turn, `steer` hands it to the running turn after its
current tool step, `interrupt` stops the turn and then runs it.

oneOf.description: Run the input as the next turn (first in, first out).
Inject the input into the running turn.
Stop the running turn, then run the input.

CapabilityText.description:
A capability string of the closed vocabulary (`pmt_core::capability`);
validation refuses any other string with `unknown capability '<s>'`.

ChatPolicy.description:
One `[[gateway.chat_policies]]` entry: what sessions of the chats it
matches get. A policy is resolved once when a session is created and
frozen for that session.

busy.description: Busy handling in matched chats (over the platform's).

max_cost_usd_per_turn.description: USD one turn of a matched session may cost.

model.description: The model of matched sessions (`[<provider>/]<model>` or an alias).

preload_skills.description:
Skills whose content opens each matched session as its first
user-side context (never in the system prompt); enabled skills
only.

rate_limit.description: Rate limits in matched chats (over the platform's).

skills.description: Skills preloaded into matched sessions; only enabled skills.

system_prompt_append.description:
Text appended to the platform hint of matched sessions' system
prompt.

thread_id.description:
Matches this thread or forum topic of the chat (more specific than
the chat alone; a chat policy also applies to its threads).

toolsets.description:
Toolsets of matched sessions; only narrows the profile's enabled
toolsets.

ChatToolProgress.description: How tool calls show in a chat.

oneOf.description: A line when the tool changes.
Every call with a longer preview, and each result.

Nothing in the chat; each call is appended to
`<home>/logs/<profile>/tool_calls.log`.

ChildApproval.description:
How an approval needed inside a child is resolved; no value approves
dangerous actions on its own.

oneOf.description: Deny and return the denial to the child.

Ask the root session's surface, tagged with the child's id; denied
when nobody answers in time.

allowed_tools.description:
Tools a script may call through its stubs; a session sees the
intersection with its own granted tools.

kernel_idle_timeout_secs.description: Seconds an unused Python kernel stays alive before it is stopped.

max_session_kernels.description:
Top-level sessions keeping a Python kernel at once; the least
recently used one loses its kernel beyond this (children's kernels
are not counted).

max_tool_calls.description: Stub calls one execution may make.

mode.description:
`project` runs scripts in the session's working directory on the
project's virtual environment (3.8 or newer) when there is one;
`strict` runs them in a fresh staging directory on the managed
Python runtime.

CodeExecutionMode.description: Where `execute_code` runs a script and on which Python.

oneOf.description:
The session's working directory and the project's virtual
environment, else the managed runtime.
A fresh staging directory and the managed runtime.

ComposerConfig.description:
The `[ui.composer]` section (spec: tui, Large pastes collapse into
chips).

paste_collapse_chars.description:
A paste of at least this many characters collapses into a chip;
`0` disables the character threshold.

paste_collapse_lines.description:
A paste of at least this many lines collapses into a chip; `0`
disables the line threshold.

abort_on_summary_failure.description: End the turn when the summary cannot be produced.

enabled.description: Compact the context automatically.

min_tail_user_messages.description: User messages always kept in the tail.

pinned_max_tokens.description: Token cap for pinned content carried across compactions.

prepare_ahead.description: Prepare the next summary ahead of the trigger.

proactive_prune_tokens.description: Prune old tool output above this many tokens; `0` is off.

protect_first_n.description: Non-system messages protected at the head of the first compaction.

quality_min_coverage.description: Minimum coverage a summary must reach.

summary_timeout_secs.description: Time allowed for one summary call.

tail_mode.description: How much recent conversation is kept verbatim.

target_ratio.description: Target size after compaction as a fraction of the input budget.

threshold.description: Fraction of the input budget at which compaction triggers.

threshold_tokens.description: Lower absolute trigger in tokens; `0` is off.

ConnectorsConfig.description:
The `[connectors]` section: hosted app integrations (Gmail, Notion,
Linear...) whose tools run on the Nous connector gateway.

connect_timeout_secs.description:
How long a connection card or `connectors connect` waits for the
user to finish signing in.

enabled.description: Offer hosted connectors when the profile has a Nous sign-in.

gateway_url.description:
The connector gateway's origin (a self-hosted gateway, or a test
server); `https` except on loopback.

env.description: Literal environment set in the container.

extra_args.description: Extra `create` arguments; anything weakening hardening is refused.

image.description: Image; empty is the release's `prometheus-sandbox` image.

network.description: Give the container a network; `false` runs it with none.

persistent.description:
One container per profile and workspace, reused by later sessions
and stopped (never removed) when idle; `false` gives each session
its own container.

run_as_host_user.description: Run as the host user's uid and gid.

runtime.description:
Runtime: `auto` (rootless Podman, else Docker), `podman`, `docker`
or the path of either executable.

shared_key.description: Sessions of the profile with the same key share one container.

engine.description: Context engine: `builtin` or an installed `context-engine` plugin.

ContinuableSurface.description: How a continuable delivery opens its conversation.

oneOf.description: A new thread (or topic) per delivery.
Top-level in the channel, seeding the channel's session.

CronConfig.description:
The `[cron]` section: the profile time zone (also the zone of daily
budgets and `usage --by day`) and the scheduled-job settings.

agent_idle_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds an agent run may go without tokens or tool activity before
it is interrupted (`0` = unlimited); a job's `timeout.idle` wins.

allow_agent_scheduling.description: Offer the `cronjob` tool inside scheduled runs.

catch_up_missed.description:
Collapse missed occurrences of a job without an explicit `grace`
into one catch-up run (otherwise they are recorded `skipped_late`).

completed_retention_secs.description:
Seconds completed jobs are kept before deletion (`0` = never
deleted).

continuable.description:
Deliveries of jobs that do not set `attach_to_session` open a
conversation a reply continues.

continuable_surface.description:
Per platform: `thread` (a new thread per continuable delivery) or
`in_channel` (posted top-level, seeding the channel's session) on
adapters that support it.

default_toolsets.description:
Toolsets of runs whose job names none; unset uses the cron
surface's default (`toolsets.surfaces.cron`, else the enabled
toolsets).

failure_nudge_threshold.description:
Consecutive failures of a recurring job after which its failure
notice suggests fixing, pausing or removing it (`0` = never).

failure_repeat_alert_secs.description:
Seconds after which a failure incident still alerted sends one
reminder (`0` = alert on every failing run).

max_parallel_jobs.description: Runs executing at once per profile (1 = serial).

max_run_secs.description:
Seconds a run may take in all (`0` = unlimited); a job's
`timeout.wall` wins.

model.description:
The model of unpinned jobs (unset: the profile's main model at fire
time).

preflight.description:
Check a job's credential, skills and delivery adapters before each
run; a failure is recorded `blocked_config` without a model call.

retry_unreachable.description:
Re-run a recurring job 5, 15 and 30 minutes after it failed to
reach the model (network or DNS), without a failure notice.

run_retention_secs.description: Seconds run records are kept (`0` = forever).

script_timeout_secs.description: Seconds a job script may run before it is killed.

tick_interval_secs.description:
Seconds between the built-in trigger's evaluations of due jobs (it
also wakes at the earliest next run).

timezone.description:
IANA time zone of this profile (`Europe/Lisbon`); unset uses the
host's zone.

wrap_response.description: Frame delivered output with the job name and a pause hint.

notify.description:
Send scheduled output and failure notices as notifying messages,
never muted as warnings.

threads.description:
Per platform: the thread or topic id home-chat deliveries go to
(explicit `<adapter>:<chat>:<thread>` targets win).

CronProvider.description:
Which trigger signals due occurrences (spec: scheduled-jobs, Pluggable
trigger provider).

oneOf.description: The ticker inside the gateway daemon (or `prometheus cron tick`).

An external managed scheduler; falls back to `builtin` with a
warning while it is unavailable.

max_entries.description:
Message ids remembered per adapter (the oldest are forgotten
first).

ttl_secs.description:
A redelivered inbound event within this many seconds is dropped
as a duplicate.

oneOf.description: A `degraded` result with a retry hint.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the direct endpoint's key.

background.description:
`auto` runs top-level spawns in the background where the session
can receive later completions; `never` always waits.

base_url.description:
A direct endpoint children call instead of a provider route
(`model`, or the parent's model id, names the model there).

child_approval.description:
What an approval a child needs does: `deny` it, or `escalate` it to
the root session's surface.

escalation_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds an escalated approval waits for an answer before it is
denied.

gateway_mode.description:
How messaging sessions run their children: `auto` waits for them
inside the call when the platform's interim assistant messages are
off, `inline` always waits, `background` never does.

inactivity_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds without progress after which a child counts as stalled
(`0` uses the built-in 450 s between iterations and 1200 s inside
one tool call; otherwise at least 30).

independent_completions.description:
Deliver each ungrouped task's result (and each `group`'s results)
as its own completion as soon as it is ready.

max_concurrent_children.description:
Children running at once across the profile, synchronous and
background alike; further spawns queue.

max_iterations.description: Model calls one child may make.

max_queued.description:
Spawns waiting for a free slot before new ones are refused with
`delegation.at_capacity`.

max_spawn_depth.description:
How deep children may spawn their own children; a child below this
depth keeps the `delegation` toolset (an orchestrator), the others
are leaves.

max_summary_chars.description:
Most characters of one child's summary inserted into the parent's
context (`0` disables the cap); the full text stays readable.

model.description:
The model children run on unless the task or its agent names one
(`provider/model`); unset: the parent's current route.

oneshot_max_children.description:
Children a finite one-shot run (`chat -z`, cron, eval) may spawn
(`0` is unlimited); interactive and gateway sessions are never
charged.

progress_events.description: Publish `subagent.*` progress events on the root session's stream.

request_overrides.description:
Request parameters set on every child model call, winning over the
route's own; the `extra_body` table is merged one level deep into
the request body.

review.description: The model `/review` runs on (unset: the session's route).

router.description:
The delegation router: `default`, or a router a plugin provides.
An unavailable router refuses every spawn.

wire_format.description:
Wire format of the direct endpoint (default: inferred from its
URL, as for a custom provider).

worktree_branch_prefix.description: Prefix of a child's worktree branch (`<prefix>/subagent-<id>`).

worktree_isolation.description:
Run each child in its own git worktree and branch when the parent
uses the local terminal backend inside a git repository.

detect_paths.description:
Deliver files a final reply names by bare path (outside code) as
uploads, removing the path from the text.

max_parts.description:
A reply that would need more parts is sent as its first part plus
a truncation notice, with the full text attached.

bell_on_complete.description: Ring the terminal bell when a turn completes.

bell_on_prompt.description: Ring the terminal bell when an approval or clarify prompt opens.

final_response_markdown.description: How the final response is printed.

interim_messages.description: Show assistant text between tool calls.

reasoning_full.description: Show reasoning in full instead of clamped.

resume_display.description: Recap printed when a session is resumed.

resume_exchanges.description: User/assistant exchanges shown in the recap.

resume_max_assistant_chars.description: Characters of non-final assistant messages shown in the recap.

resume_max_assistant_lines.description: Lines of non-final assistant messages shown in the recap.

resume_max_user_chars.description: User message characters shown in the recap.

show_cost.description: Show the session cost in the status line.

theme.description:
Theme: a built-in (`default`, `mono`, `daylight`, `slate`) or a
file in `<profile>/themes/`.

tool_preview_length.description: Tool preview length in characters; `0` means no limit.

tool_progress.description: Tool activity shown while a turn runs.

tool_progress_grouping.description: How consecutive tool calls are grouped.

turn_summary.description: One line with duration, tool count and tokens after each turn.

vim_mode.description:
Vim key bindings in the composer (the line editor is set up when
the session starts).

allow_private.description: Allow private destinations without a session grant.

deny.description:
Hosts refused in every mode (`*` globs, `host` or `host:port`, e.g.
`*.casino.example`); a session can add to them, never remove.

deny_files.description:
Absolute paths of shared blocklist files: one pattern per line, `#`
comments; re-read when a file changes.

fake_ip_ranges.description: CIDR ranges a local TUN proxy answers with (treated as public).

mode.description:
Which hosts tools, sandboxed children, plugins and browsers may
reach: any public address (`public`), only the `allow` patterns
(`allowlist`) or nothing (`none`). A session can narrow or extend
it (`chat --egress`, `/egress`, `egress.set`).

oneOf.description: Any public address; private and metadata ranges denied.
Only hosts named by `security.egress.allow` (or a session grant).

cost_threshold_usd.description:
Estimated input cost (USD) of one empty attempt at which the retry
budget drops to one.

chain.description:
Ordered fallback routes (`[[fallback.chain]]`); empty disables
fallback.

min_health.description: Fallback entries with a health score below this are skipped.

credential.description: Name of the secret this entry uses instead of the provider's.

snapshot.description: File snapshots, undo and rollback checkpoints.

file.description:
A file of accepted values, one per line, relative to the profile
directory.

base_url.description:
Self-hosted Firecrawl base URL; unset is the hosted API
(`https://api.firecrawl.dev`, secret `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`).

max_per_chat.description:
Background tasks one chat may have running at once; more are
refused.

burst_window_ms.description:
Follow-up chunks of the same bot in the same chat within this many
milliseconds join the same turn (default 1500).

human_user_ids.description:
Senders treated as people although their messages are marked as a
bot's (posts made with the owner's own user token).

require_inline_mention.description:
An admitted bot message starts a turn only with a literal inline
mention of this bot; a reply ping alone does not (default true).

ack.description: Send one busy acknowledgement per conversation per 30 seconds.

debounce_cap_ms.description: An input is never held longer than this for more text.

debounce_ms.description:
Text arriving within this many milliseconds of the previous text
joins it into one input.

accept_routes_from.description: Profiles whose `profile_routes` may route events to this one.

agent_cache.description: Live agents kept in memory (read from the launch profile).

bots.description: Messages other bots send, overridable per platform.

busy.description:
Input that arrives while a turn runs (the mode itself is
`busy.input_mode`, overridable per platform).

chat_policies.description:
Per-chat policies; each applies to sessions created after it
changed (`/policy apply --now` replaces a chat's session at once).

display.description:
How turns look in a chat (tool progress, footers, notices),
overridable per platform.

groups.description:
When group, channel and thread messages start a turn, overridable
per platform.

mcp_events.description: MCP server notifications as internal webhook events.

message_timestamps.description: The send time in front of each user message the model sees.

multiplex.description:
In the daemon's launch profile: serve every profile of the home
(each in its own scope) instead of the launch profile only.

platforms.description:
Messaging platforms this profile answers on, keyed by platform
(`telegram`, `discord`, ...). A profile clone leaves them out
unless `--clone-channels` is given, so two profiles never answer
the same bot account.

profile_routes.description:
Events this profile's adapters receive that belong to another
served profile (one shared bot, several communities); the target
must list this profile in its `accept_routes_from`.

proxy_url.description:
The proxy every adapter without its own `proxy_url` uses
(`http://`, `https://` or `socks5://`, without a password; a URL
with credentials goes in a secret named by `proxy_url_secret`).

proxy_url_secret.description:
The secret holding the shared proxy URL when it carries
credentials.

quick_commands.description: `exec` quick commands run from a chat.

rate_limit.description: Per-sender rate limits (overridable per platform and chat policy).

reconnect_attention_secs.description:
An adapter outside `connected` for longer than this is flagged for
attention (`adapter.state`, `/platforms`, `gateway status`) and the
profile's other home channels are told once per outage.

session_stall_timeout_secs.description:
A running turn with no model output, tool progress or tool result
for this long gets one no-progress notice in its chat; after twice
as long it is interrupted as stalled. `0` disables the watchdog.

shutdown.description: Stopping the daemon (read from the launch profile).

standalone.description:
Never serve this profile from a multiplexing daemon (it gets a
daemon of its own home).

trust_env.description:
Honour inherited proxy environment variables (`HTTPS_PROXY`, ...)
and the OS proxy settings when no proxy is configured; off, adapters
connect directly.

GatewayDelegationMode.description: How a messaging session runs its children.

oneOf.description: Wait inside the call where interim assistant messages are off.
Never wait: children report as later completions.

busy_ack_detail.description:
Busy acknowledgements name what the running turn is doing (default
false).

cleanup_progress.description:
Delete the progress bubbles after a successful final reply on
adapters that can delete (default false).

interim_assistant_messages.description: Send what the model says between tool calls (default true).

long_running_notifications.description:
One edited `Working — <n> min` bubble every 180 seconds of a long
turn (default true).

runtime_footer.description:
Append a model / context / directory footer to final replies
(default false; `/footer on|off` per chat).

suppress_warning_notifications.description:
Mute automatic warning and error notices on this destination
(default false; logs and stored state are unchanged).

tool_preview_length.description: Characters of a tool call's arguments shown (default 40).

tool_progress_command.description: `/verbose` cycles the chat's tool progress mode (default false).

GatewayGroups.description: `[gateway.groups]`: when group, channel and thread messages start a turn.

history_backfill.description:
Give a mention-triggered turn the channel's messages since the
bot's last reply (default true on Discord and Slack).

ignored_chats.description: Chats and threads that never start a turn.

mention_patterns.description:
Case-insensitive regular expressions that count as a mention (at
most 32).

observe_unmentioned.description:
Keep unmentioned messages of authorized group chats in the chat's
session as attributed context, without a turn (default false).

require_mention.description:
Only messages that mention the bot, reply to it, match a
`mention_patterns` entry or are in a thread it takes part in start a
turn (default true).

thread_require_mention.description:
A thread the bot takes part in still needs a mention (default
false).

GatewayHealthConfig.description:
The `[observability.gateway_health]` section (spec: messaging-gateway,
Gateway health export is opt-in and content-free): allowlisted gateway,
adapter, outbox and cron gauges and counters with bounded attributes,
posted as OTLP/HTTP JSON metrics; never message text, user ids, chat
ids or secrets.

enabled.description: Export gateway health. Off by default: nothing is sent.

endpoint.description:
The OTLP/HTTP metrics endpoint (`https://`, or `http://` to a
loopback collector), e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4318/v1/metrics`.

timeout_secs.description:
An `exec` quick command run from a chat is killed, with its whole
process tree, after this many seconds.

group_per_user.description:
Each member of a non-thread group or channel gets a session of
their own.

resume_pending_ttl_secs.description:
A turn left `resume_pending` by a restart holds its chat's queue
until `/retry` or `/discard`, at most this long; then it is
discarded automatically.

route_max_age_secs.description:
Routes (conversation to session, never transcripts) unused this
long are pruned; `0` keeps them forever.

stuck_loop_threshold.description:
A session whose turn was running during this many consecutive
daemon restarts is suspended; its next message starts a new one.

thread_per_user.description: Each participant of a thread gets a session of their own.

GuardrailThresholds.description: Repetition thresholds of the tool loop guardrails.

exact_failure.description: Same tool, same arguments, same error.

GuidanceMode.description: What a security guidance finding does to a write.

oneOf.description: The write proceeds; its result lists the findings.
The write is refused with the guidance as the reason.

HomeChannel.description:
`[gateway.platforms.<name>.home_channel]`: the default destination of
scheduled output, platform-only send targets and notices without an
originating chat.

name.description: A display name (also accepted as `platform:#name` in send targets).

thread_id.description: The thread (forum topic) inside the chat.

auto_accept.description:
Run shell hooks nobody approved yet without asking (as
`--accept-hooks` does for one run); every hook still runs in the
session's sandbox.

outbound.description: Outbound webhooks: hook events sent as HTTPS `POST` requests.

oneOf.description: Pixels when the main route supports vision, else a description.
Never attach pixels; use a `vision` auxiliary description.

anyOf.description: On for models whose name contains one of these substrings.

IntentContinuation.description: `agent.intent_continuation`: a mode, a switch or model-name substrings.

KeyChord.description:
A key chord: `[Ctrl+][Alt+][Shift+]<key>` (spec: tui, Configurable key
bindings).

enabled.description: Allow keyless web search as the last `auto` choice.

max_web_searches.description: Web searches per turn; `0` is unlimited.

broken_retry_secs.description:
After a server fails to start or times out, skip it for its
workspace this long (`0` = until `prometheus lsp restart` or the
process exits).

enabled.description:
Run language servers after `write_file` and `patch`; `false` starts
no server, watcher or background task.

exclude_roots.description:
Git roots where no server runs (globs, `~` expanded; a bare path
also matches everything below it).

idle_timeout_secs.description:
Shut down a server idle this long; it restarts on demand (`0` =
never).

install_strategy.description:
`auto` installs missing `npm`, `go` and `pip` servers on first use;
`manual` uses only binaries on `PATH`.

package_manager.description:
The package manager of `npm`-method installs; one that is not
installed skips the install (never another manager).

servers.description:
Overrides of built-in servers by id, and custom servers under any
other key.

trusted_workspaces.description:
Workspaces trusted beyond the one the session was pointed at
(globs, `~` expanded; a bare path also matches everything below
it). Servers that execute project code start only in trusted
workspaces.

wait_mode.description:
`document` checks the edited file; `full` also asks for workspace
diagnostics.

wait_timeout_ms.description:
Longest wait for a verdict before the turn's final answer is
accepted, and the bound of one check.

warmup_timeout_ms.description:
Bound of the first check against a server that is not running yet
(`0` = `wait_timeout_ms`).

oneOf.description: npm (the managed Node's own when installed).

LspServerConfig.description:
One `[lsp.servers.<id>]` entry: an override of a built-in server, or
a custom server (`command` and `extensions` required).

description.description: Custom servers: what it is, for `prometheus lsp list`.

env.description: Extra environment of the server (non-secret values).

extensions.description: Custom servers: the file extensions it checks (`.ml2`).

initialization_options.description: Merged into the server's initialization options.

language_id.description: Custom servers: the LSP language id (default: the extension).

root_markers.description: Custom servers: files whose directory is the server's root.

LspWaitMode.description: What a check asks the server for.

oneOf.description: The edited file's and the workspace's.

McpCapabilities.description:
`[mcp.servers.<name>.capabilities]`: the sandbox of a `stdio` server,
in the words of a plugin manifest.

fs_read.description: Paths it may read: absolute, or under `$workspace`.

fs_write.description: Paths it may write: absolute, or under `$workspace`.

McpConfig.description:
The `[mcp]` section: the external MCP servers the profile's sessions
connect to.

auto_reload_on_config_change.description:
The daemon applies `mcp.servers` edits within a minute (new
sessions only).

call_timeout_secs.description: Bound on one tool call of a server that sets no `timeout_secs`.

connect_timeout_secs.description:
Bound on starting and initializing a server that sets no
`connect_timeout_secs`.

discovery_concurrency.description: Servers connected at once when a session needs them.

discovery_wait_ms.description:
How long an interactive session start waits for servers still
connecting; later ones join later sessions.

servers.description:
Servers by name; their tools register as `mcp__<name>__<tool>` in
toolset `mcp-<name>`.

single_query_discovery_wait_ms.description: The same wait for one-shot `-q` runs.

enabled.description: Route the server's form requests to the person.

Admit notifications of configured MCP servers that declare an
`events` webhook route as signed internal events on that route
(same delivery and toolset rules as a webhook request).

client_id.description:
A client registered with the authorization server beforehand (for
servers without dynamic client registration).

client_name.description: The client name sent at dynamic registration.

client_secret_name.description: Secrets-store name of that client's secret.

redirect_port.description: A fixed callback port (0: any free port).

redirect_uri.description:
A full redirect URI registered with the client (overrides host and
port).

scopes.description: Requested scopes (default: what the server advertises).

timeout_secs.description: How long a login waits for the person.

oneOf.description: Authorization code with PKCE and a loopback (or pasted) redirect.

allowed_models.description: When not empty, `model` must be one of these.

enabled.description:
Default: on for `trust = "full"` servers, off for `untrusted`
ones.

max_tokens_cap.description: Requested answer sizes are capped at this.

max_tool_rounds.description: Tool rounds of one sampling exchange.

model.description: The model answering instead of the session's.

auth.description:
How an `http` server authenticates: `header` (the `auth_secret`
bearer token) or `oauth` (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, `prometheus mcp
login`).

auth_secret.description: Secrets-store name of the bearer token sent to an `http` server.

capabilities.description: What a `stdio` server's sandbox lets it reach, like a plugin grant.

client_cert.description:
A PEM file holding the client certificate (and its key unless
`client_key` is set) presented to an `https` server.

client_key.description: The PEM file of the client certificate's private key.

client_key_password_secret.description: Secrets-store name of the password of an encrypted `client_key`.

command.description:
The program of a `stdio` server (a bare name is looked up on
`PATH`).

enabled.description: `false` skips the server without connecting.

env.description:
Environment variables of a `stdio` server, literal values. A
`stdio` server gets only these, `env_secrets` and `PATH`, `HOME`,
`LANG`, `SYSTEMROOT` and `TMPDIR`.

env_secrets.description:
Secrets-store names passed to a `stdio` server as environment
variables of the same name.

headers.description:
Headers sent with every request to an `http` server (`${NAME}`
placeholders come from the secrets store).

identity_header.description:
`{ name, value_from = "static" | "profile", value }`: a header sent
with every request naming the caller (the literal `value` or the
profile name); never overrides a same-named `headers` entry. An
invalid block, or one on a `stdio` server, is warned and ignored.

idle_timeout_secs.description:
Stop a `stdio` server after this many idle seconds (0: never); it
restarts on its next call.

lazy.description:
Register the tools from the schema cache and start the server on
its first call.

max_lifetime_secs.description:
Stop a `stdio` server this many seconds after it started (0:
never); it restarts on its next call.

oauth.description: The OAuth client of an `auth = "oauth"` server.

spend_limit.description:
The most one conversation may spend on this server's tools before
each further costed call asks (0: no limit).

tool_costs.description:
What the server's tools cost: a number, or `{ credits = [min, max],
note = "..." }`, per tool name. A malformed entry skips the server.

tools.description: Which of the server's tools register.

trust.description:
`untrusted` servers' tools need approval unless they declare
`readOnlyHint`; `full` trusts them like built-in tools.

url.description: The endpoint of an `http` (streamable HTTP) server.

McpServerModeConfig.description:
The `[mcp_server]` section: what `prometheus mcp serve` offers MCP
clients.

allow_remote.description: Let `--http` bind an address that is not loopback.

expose_toolsets.description:
Toolsets exposed as MCP tools; `skills` exposes only the read-only
skill tools.

exclude.description: Tool names (exact or globs) never registered.

include.description:
Whitelist of the server's tool names (exact or case-sensitive
globs); wins over `exclude`, and an empty list registers nothing.

oneOf.description: A child process speaking JSON-RPC on its stdin and stdout.
Every tool not declaring `readOnlyHint` needs approval.

cache_max_age_secs.description:
Cached inbound media older than this many seconds is deleted
unless a kept session references it.

max_inbound_bytes.description:
Largest inbound attachment downloaded, in bytes; `0` disables the
cap.

memory_char_limit.description: Character budget of core memory entries.

nudge_interval.description:
User turns without a memory call before a background review; `0`
disables.

review_mode.description: How agent memory changes are reviewed.

user_char_limit.description: Character budget of core user-profile entries.

oneOf.description: Stage every agent change as pending.

enabled.description:
Prefix each user message the model sees with its send time in the
profile's time zone (`[Tue 2026-04-28 13:40:53 CEST]`). Frozen per
session when it is created: a change applies to new sessions.

oneOf.description:
`direct` when Modal secrets exist, else `managed` when a
subscription is signed in, else unavailable.

anyOf.description: A route with its own endpoint or secret.

aliases.description:
User model aliases: a name (matched case-insensitively) for a
`"<provider>/<model>"` string or a route table. Usable wherever a
model is named (`/model`, `prometheus model set`, fallback and
auxiliary slots).

auto_order.description: Provider order tried by `auto` among providers with a stored secret.

min_context_window.description: Smallest context window (tokens) a session may start with.

provider.description: Provider id or alias; unset means `auto`.

anyOf.description: A route with optional metadata overrides.

ModelEntry.description:
One `[models]` entry: an alias string `"<provider>/<model>"` or a route
and metadata table.

reasoning.description:
Reasoning tokens (a part of the output tokens); unset bills them at
the output price.

key_secret.description: Name of the secret for this route.

max_reasoning_effort.description:
Highest reasoning effort the model accepts; higher requested
levels are clamped down to it.

supports_tools.description: Whether the model takes tool schemas.

supports_video.description: Whether the model takes video input.

supports_vision.description: Whether the model takes image input.

extra_ca_file.description: Extra PEM CA bundle trusted in addition to the platform store.

force_ipv4.description:
Resolve and connect every outbound client (providers, MCP over HTTP,
web tools, adapters, OTLP, downloads) over IPv4 only; loopback
listeners are unaffected. Set it when `prometheus doctor network
--online` reports a blackholed IPv6 route.

background.description: Which background process and subagent events reach the chat.

OAuthEndpoints.description:
A `[providers.<id>.oauth]` table: sign-in endpoints. Endpoints must be
`https://` (plain `http://` only on a loopback address) and their hosts
must be in `allowed_hosts`.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts the sign-in endpoints may be on (exact, or a leading `*.`).

authorize_url.description: Authorization endpoint of the browser (PKCE) flow.

device_authorization_url.description: Device authorization endpoint of the device-code flow.

device_poll_url.description:
Polling endpoint of a device flow that polls somewhere other than
the token endpoint (OpenAI's).

redirect_port.description:
Loopback redirect port of the browser flow; 0 lets the OS assign
one (only for providers that accept any port).

revoke_url.description: Token revocation endpoint (`auth remove` revokes the refresh token).

verification_url.description:
Page where the user enters the device code, when the device
endpoint does not name one.

gateway_health.description: The gateway daemon's health export (read from the launch profile).

events.description: The hook events delivered (names of the closed hook registry).

matcher.description: A regular expression the tool name must match (tool events only).

name.description: Unique name (logs and `prometheus plugins hooks list`).

secret_name.description:
The secrets-store entry whose value signs each delivery
(`X-Prometheus-Signature-256`); unsigned without one.

timeout_secs.description: How long one delivery attempt may take.

url.description:
Where events are sent (`POST`): `https://`, or `http://` to a loopback
address.

max_age_secs.description: An entry older than this becomes `failed`.

max_attempts.description: Send attempts before an entry becomes `failed`.

PhraseMode.description: How a status phrase file combines with the built-in phrases.

PlatformBots.description: One platform's overrides; each unset key inherits.

burst_window_ms.description:
Follow-up chunks of the same bot in the same chat within this many
milliseconds join the same turn (default 1500).

human_user_ids.description:
Senders treated as people although their messages are marked as a
bot's (posts made with the owner's own user token).

require_inline_mention.description:
An admitted bot message starts a turn only with a literal inline
mention of this bot; a reply ping alone does not (default true).

PlatformConfig.description: One `[gateway.platforms.<name>]` table: the keys every adapter shares.

admins.description: User ids with every command in direct messages.

allow_all.description: Admit everyone (logged at WARN on every start).

allow_chats.description: Chats every member of which is admitted.

allow_roles.description:
Role ids whose holders are authorized (Discord roles, Slack user
groups, Matrix power levels), checked right after `allow_users` on
adapters that expose roles; a failed role lookup denies.

allow_users.description:
Platform user ids admitted without pairing (no wildcards: use
`allow_all`).

batching.description:
Joins rapid consecutive text of one sender into one input (a
client that splits a long paste); replaces the busy debounce on
this platform when set.

busy.description:
Busy handling on this platform (overrides `busy.input_mode` and
`gateway.busy`).

enabled.description: Start this adapter with the daemon.

group_admins.description: User ids with every command in groups.

home_channel.description:
The chat that receives scheduled output, platform-only send
targets and notifications without an originating chat (`/sethome`
sets it).

human_delay_ms.description:
A uniformly random delay `[min, max]` in milliseconds before each
outbound part. Unset: none.

max_body_bytes.description:
Largest request body a webhook route reads (`webhook` only), in
bytes; larger requests are answered 413 unread. Unset: 1048576.

max_message_length.description:
Lowers the adapter's message length limit (in its own unit); it
can never raise it.

options.description:
The adapter's own settings, validated against the schema it
publishes (`prometheus gateway platforms` lists the adapters).

proxy_url.description:
The proxy this adapter's outbound HTTP and WebSocket traffic uses
(`http://`, `https://` or `socks5://`, without a password; a URL
with credentials goes in a secret named by `proxy_url_secret`).
Unset: `gateway.proxy_url`.

proxy_url_secret.description:
The secret holding this adapter's proxy URL when it carries
credentials.

reactions.description:
Mark the triggering message with processing reactions (eyes, then a
check mark or a cross). Unset: on for Discord and Slack, off
elsewhere.

reply_to_mode.description:
Which parts of a reply quote the message they answer: none, the
first part, or every part. Unset: `first`.

restart_notification.description:
Post one notice to this platform's home channel after a graceful
restart or update that interrupted running turns (default true).

routes.description:
Webhook routes by name (`webhook` only), each served at
`/p/<profile>/webhook/<route>` on the shared listener.

token_secret.description: The secret holding the adapter's credential (never the value).

typing_indicator.description:
Show the platform's typing indicator while a turn runs. Unset:
`true`.

unauthorized_dm.description:
What an unauthorized direct message gets: a pairing code (`pair`),
nothing (`ignore`) or a refusal (`decline`). Unset: `ignore` for
email or when `allow_users` is set, else `pair`.

user_commands.description:
Commands other users may run where an admin list is set, besides
`/help`, `/whoami`, `/stop`, `/new`, `/queue` and `/link`.

PlatformDisplay.description:
One platform's display overrides; each unset key inherits from
`[gateway.display]`, then the built-in default.

busy_ack_detail.description:
Busy acknowledgements name what the running turn is doing (default
false).

cleanup_progress.description:
Delete the progress bubbles after a successful final reply on
adapters that can delete (default false).

interim_assistant_messages.description: Send what the model says between tool calls (default true).

long_running_notifications.description:
One edited `Working — <n> min` bubble every 180 seconds of a long
turn (default true).

runtime_footer.description:
Append a model / context / directory footer to final replies
(default false; `/footer on|off` per chat).

suppress_warning_notifications.description:
Mute automatic warning and error notices on this destination
(default false; logs and stored state are unchanged).

tool_preview_length.description: Characters of a tool call's arguments shown (default 40).

tool_progress_command.description: `/verbose` cycles the chat's tool progress mode (default false).

PlatformGroups.description: One platform's overrides; each unset key inherits.

history_backfill.description:
Give a mention-triggered turn the channel's messages since the
bot's last reply (default true on Discord and Slack).

ignored_chats.description: Chats and threads that never start a turn.

mention_patterns.description:
Case-insensitive regular expressions that count as a mention (at
most 32).

observe_unmentioned.description:
Keep unmentioned messages of authorized group chats in the chat's
session as attributed context, without a turn (default false).

require_mention.description:
Only messages that mention the bot, reply to it, match a
`mention_patterns` entry or are in a thread it takes part in start a
turn (default true).

thread_require_mention.description:
A thread the bot takes part in still needs a mention (default
false).

enabled.description:
`false` turns streaming off for this platform; `true` cannot turn
it on while `gateway.streaming.enabled` is off.

approval_transport.description:
The plugin approval transport that presents approval requests,
`<plugin_id>:<name>`; empty asks on the session's own surface.

approval_transport_fallback.description:
What a failing, timed-out, unbound or missing approval transport
leads to: `deny` the request, or ask on the session's own surface
(`builtin`).

catalog_url.description:
Where the signed live plugin catalog is fetched from (cached 6 hours
under the profile's `cache/`); empty uses only the catalog embedded
in the binary.

enabled.description:
Ids of the non-embedded plugins to instantiate; a discovered plugin
stays disabled until listed here (`prometheus plugins enable <id>`).

entries.description:
Each plugin's own settings, `plugins.entries.<id>.<key>`, read and
written by the plugin through its `config` host interface.

hook_context_max_chars.description:
`pre_llm_call` context of one callback above this many characters
is spilled to `hook_outputs/<session>/` and replaced by its head,
tail and the spill path.

hook_timeout_ms.description:
Bound on one hook callback; a callback that overruns counts as no
result and is suspended for 60 seconds.

load_timeout_ms.description:
Bound on instantiating and registering one plugin; a plugin that
overruns is skipped with `load timed out` while the others load.

safe_mode.description:
Skip every non-embedded plugin, MCP server and python-bridge
sidecar (as `prometheus --safe-mode` does, without its other effects).

scan_on_install.description:
Statically scan every plugin install and update for threats
(reverse shells, credential exfiltration, destructive commands,
persistence, obfuscated execution, prompt injection); `false` skips
the scan and the install record says so.

signature_policy.description:
What installing an unsigned local `.pmtpkg` needs: `require` (only
with `--allow-unsigned`), `warn` or `off`. Catalog installs always
need a valid signature unless `--allow-unsigned` is given.

trusted_project_dirs.description:
Project roots whose `.prometheus/plugins/` directory is scanned;
any other project's plugins are never read.

call_timeout_ms.description:
CPU bound of one call into a plugin (fuel and epoch interruption);
an overrun fails the call with `plugin '<id>' exceeded call timeout`.

max_memory_bytes.description: Linear memory cap of one plugin instance.

PolicyChatType.description: The chat kinds a policy can match.

oneOf.description: Threads inside a group or channel.
Use the first healthy credential until it is benched.

owner_emails.description: The profile owner's email addresses, which `redact_pii` keeps.

redact_pii.description:
Replace phone numbers, other people's email addresses and messaging
user ids (with a stable `user_<hash>`) in what reaches model
providers, logs, trajectories and telemetry.

guild_id.description: Matches this workspace or server (Discord guild, Slack team).

platform.description: The platform whose events it routes.

profile.description: The served profile matching events go to.

thread_id.description:
Matches this thread or forum topic (a channel route also matches
its threads).

oneOf.description:
Five minutes for machine-paced sessions (subagent, cron, webhook,
kanban, api, batch), one hour otherwise; resolved once per session.

context_file_max_chars.description:
Character cap per context file; `0` derives it from the model's
context window.

context_file_read_timeout_secs.description: Time allowed to read each context file.

include_session_id.description: Add `Session ID: ses_<ULID>` to the session tier.

load_context_files.description: Load project context files (`AGENTS.md` and friends).

platform_hints.description: Per-platform hint overrides, keyed by platform.

oneOf.description: An API key from the secrets store.
A short-lived token minted from a longer-lived credential.
A credential printed by an external command.

ProviderConfig.description: One `[providers.<id>]` override of a built-in or custom provider.

aliases.description: Extra names a custom provider answers to.

allow_insecure_http.description:
Allow a plain `http://` base URL on a public host (plain HTTP to
loopback and private-network hosts is always allowed).

auth.description:
Credential kind of a custom provider; unset uses the built-in
provider's, or `api_key` when `key_secret` is set and `none`
otherwise.

catalog_ttl_secs.description: Lifetime of the cached live model listing.

enabled.description:
`false` makes every request to this provider fail with
`provider.disabled`.

key_hosts.description:
Hostnames the provider's secret may be sent to (exact, or a leading
`*.` wildcard).

key_secret.description: Name of the secret holding this provider's key.

login_flow.description: Sign-in flow for OAuth providers; unset uses the provider default.

max_retries.description: Same-route retries of a retryable failure.

oauth.description:
Sign-in endpoints replacing (field by field) the built-in ones, or
configuring a sign-in for a custom `auth = "oauth"` provider.

plan_notes.description:
Eligibility and billing notes shown before sign-in and by `auth
status`; replaces the provider's built-in notes.

prefer_credential.description: Which credential wins when both exist.

script.description: Script file of the built-in `mock` provider.

supports_model_listing.description:
Whether the provider lists its models; unset uses the provider
default (true for custom providers).

supports_prompt_cache.description:
Whether the provider honours a prompt cache key; unset uses the
provider default (false for custom providers).

wire_format.description: Wire format; wins over host rules and the provider's own format.

allow_unbounded_requirements.description:
Accept requirements without an upper bound (`requests>=2`); by
default they are refused so an install never picks up a new major.

call_timeout_ms.description:
Bound on one call into a sidecar (hook calls use
`plugins.hook_timeout_ms`).

idle_shutdown_secs.description:
Stop a sidecar that has no hooks or providers after this many idle
seconds (`0` keeps it running).

max_memory_bytes.description:
Resident memory of one sidecar's process tree; above it the sidecar
is terminated as a crash.

max_processes.description:
Processes in one sidecar's tree; above it the sidecar is terminated
as a crash.

python_version.description:
The managed CPython every bridged plugin, skill environment and
named environment runs on (`3.11`, `3.12` or `3.13`).

QuickCommand.description: One `[quick_commands.<name>]` entry: a user slash command.

command.description:
The shell command an `exec` entry runs, with every secret removed
from its environment and its output redacted.

target.description:
The slash command an `alias` runs (with or without the leading
`/`); the user's arguments are appended.

timeout_secs.description: An `exec` command is killed after this many seconds.

type.description:
`alias` re-dispatches `target`; `exec` runs `command` in the local
sandbox.

RateLimitConfig.description:
`[gateway.rate_limit]`: per-sender limits (admins and local clients are
exempt).

burst.description: Messages a sender may send at once above the sustained rate.

daily_cost_usd.description:
USD a sender's turns may cost per local day (from the usage
ledger); unset is no cap.

messages_per_minute.description: Messages a sender may send per minute (sustained rate).

turns_per_hour.description: Turns a sender may start per hour.

RateLimitOverride.description:
Overrides of `[gateway.rate_limit]` (per platform or chat policy); unset
keys keep the shared value.

ReasoningLevel.description: Reasoning effort levels, in increasing order.

oneOf.description: Beyond maximum where a route supports it.

max_chars.description: Character cap of recalled content per turn.

ReplyToMode.description: Which parts of a reply quote the message they answer.

default_chars.description: Characters kept inline for tools without a declared cap.

mcp_chars.description: Characters kept inline for MCP tools.

overrides.description: Per-tool overrides: tool name to characters.

oneOf.description: Title, message count and last activity only.

model.description:
The reviewer's model (with `provider`, a model id there; alone,
`provider/model`).

allow_degraded.description:
Hardening features that may be missing; anything else missing
refuses to run.

url.description:
Base URL of the SearXNG instance (its JSON output must be enabled);
`searxng` is unavailable until it is set.

Seconds.description:
A number of seconds whose default is `DEFAULT` (a top-level key of a
section that otherwise derives its defaults).

Seconds2.description:
A number of seconds whose default is `DEFAULT` (a top-level key of a
section that otherwise derives its defaults).

SecretCommandConfig.description:
The `[secrets.command]` section: a helper run once per process start,
without a shell, whose stdout lines `NAME=VALUE` become secrets.

argv.description: The helper's program and arguments (no shell).

enabled.description: Run the helper (off by default; unsupported on Windows).

override_existing.description: Let helper values win over the secrets store and the environment.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds before the helper's process group is killed.

SecretName.description:
The name of a secret in the secrets store (`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$`).
Config keys that need a credential hold a name, never the value.

backend.description: Where this profile's secrets are stored.

command.description: A helper command printing `NAME=VALUE` lines (POSIX only).

acked_advisories.description:
Supply-chain advisory ids whose startup warning is silenced
(`prometheus doctor --ack <id>`); `doctor security` still shows them.

capabilities.description:
Profile capability baseline; unset uses the built-in baseline
(workspace read/write, toolchain read, `process.spawn:*`, egress
policy, `llm.call`).

protected_instruction_extra_patterns.description:
Extra instruction-file basename globs (case-insensitive), e.g.
`"*.mdc"`; writes to matches need human approval in every mode.

protected_instruction_files.description: Require human approval for agent writes to instruction files.

redact_secrets.description: Redact every loaded secret value everywhere output is written.

mode.description:
`warn` (write, then report the matched rules), `block` (refuse the
write with the guidance) or `off`.

auto_archive_secs.description: Archive lineage tips idle for this long.

max_export_messages.description: Refuse in-memory exports with more messages.

max_resume_messages.description: Refuse to resume a lineage with more messages; `0` disables.

retention_secs.description: Prune ended sessions inactive for longer than this; `0` never prunes.

terminal_continue.description: `-c` prefers the session last used from the same terminal.

command.description:
The program and its arguments, split like a shell would but run
without one; the event's JSON arrives on stdin.

fail_closed.description:
`pre_tool_call` only: a hook that fails (cannot start, times out,
answers garbage) blocks the call instead of letting it run.

matcher.description: A regular expression the tool name must match (tool events only).

timeout_secs.description: How long one run may take (clamped to 300).

drain_timeout_secs.description:
A stop whose conversations finish within this many seconds is
clean: the next start skips crash recovery.

oneOf.description: An unsigned local package installs only with `--allow-unsigned`.
An unsigned local package installs with a warning.
Local packages are not checked for a signature.

image.description: A SIF path or a `docker://` reference.

auto_load.description: Skills loaded into every new session.

config.description: Non-secret per-skill settings: skill to key to value.

creation_nudge_interval.description: Tool-calling iterations before a skill-creation nudge.

external_dirs.description: Extra skill directories (`~` expanded; missing ones skipped).

index_description_chars.description: Description length in the skills index.

inline_shell.description: Expand inline shell snippets at load.

inline_shell_timeout_ms.description: Deadline of one inline shell snippet.

platform_disabled.description: Disabled skill names per platform or surface.

project_discovery.description: Scan for untrusted project skills and show a notice.

trusted_project_dirs.description: Git roots whose project-local skills are trusted.

write_approval.description: Stage skill writes as pending for review.

enabled.description:
Record file-tool changes (`/undo`) and checkpoints (`/rollback`);
`chat --checkpoints` / `--no-checkpoints` override it per run.

max_bytes.description: The profile's snapshot store is pruned, oldest first, above this.

max_file_bytes.description: Larger files are listed as skipped instead of stored.

retention_secs.description: Snapshots unused this long are pruned.

terminal.description:
Also checkpoint before destructive terminal commands (`rm`, `mv`,
`sed -i`, `>`, `git reset`...).

oneOf.description: Checkpoint the command's project before a destructive command.

config_file.description:
An `ssh_config` file passed with `-F` (identity, known hosts, jump
hosts); unset uses the user's.

workspace.description: The remote workspace synced back to the host.

StatusPhrases.description:
`status_phrases`: the working-status phrases a surface rotates through
(never interpolating tool arguments).

path.description:
A file under the profile directory, one phrase per line (at most
80 phrases of 160 characters).

journal_mode.description:
`state.db` journal mode; `delete` only for filesystems without WAL
support.

StreamTransport.description: How a streamed draft reaches a platform.

oneOf.description:
`native` where the platform streams natively, else `edit` where it
edits messages, else no streaming.

The platform's own streaming message API (falls back to `edit`,
also mid-turn when the stream fails).
One message edited as the answer grows.

buffer_threshold.description: Characters gathered before the first draft is sent.

cursor.description: Shown at the end of a draft still being written.

edit_interval_ms.description: Least time between two edits of a draft.

enabled.description:
Stream answers while they are written. A platform can turn it off
for itself, never on when this is off.

transport.description: How a streamed draft reaches the platform.

SurfaceToolsets.description:
`[toolsets.surfaces]`: one optional toolset list per session surface.
An unset surface starts from `tools.enabled_toolsets`, where `core`
stands for the surface's built-in default.

gateway.description:
Messaging sessions per platform (`gateway.<platform>`, default
`platform-<platform>`; `gateway.webhook` defaults to
`webhook-safe`).

enabled.description: Send redacted aggregate counters.

auto_source_bashrc.description: Source `~/.bashrc` once when the shell is bash.

cwd.description: Start directory for `local`; unset is the launch directory.

degraded_mode.description: Backend connection failures: degraded results or errors.

env_passthrough.description: Non-secret launch-environment variables passed to children.

idle_lifetime_secs.description: Idle time before a cached environment is torn down.

max_foreground_secs.description: Longer foreground calls become tracked background processes.

process_wait_auto_notify.description:
Two `process` `poll`/`wait` calls in a row that find a running
process silent switch on its completion notification (where the
session can receive one).

shell_init_files.description: Extra files sourced at shell start (`~` expanded).

shell_init_timeout_secs.description: Bound on the whole shell init step.

sync_back.description:
Copy files changed in a remote workspace back to the host workspace
at session end and on `/sync`; unset is `true` for `ssh` and `false`
for every other backend.

sync_back_max_bytes.description:
Total bytes one sync-back copies; larger files are skipped and
listed.

windows_bash_path.description: Git Bash path tried first by `windows_shell = "auto"`.

oneOf.description: List the deferred tools within the listing budget.

hard_stop_enabled.description:
Stop the turn (`guardrail_stop`) at `hard_stop_after` on
interactive surfaces.

non_interactive_hard_stop_enabled.description:
Stop the turn at `hard_stop_after` on gateway, cron, API and kanban
sessions.

warnings_enabled.description:
Append a warning to the tool result when a `warn_after` threshold is
reached.

max_chars.description: Terminal output characters kept (40% head, 60% tail).

oneOf.description: A line only when the tool changes.
Consecutive calls share one updating line.

ToolSearchConfig.description:
The `[tools.tool_search]` section (spec: tool-system, Tool search
progressive disclosure; Tool search listing, ranking and limits).

defer.description:
Tools deferred besides MCP and plugin tools while tool search is
active; unset defers `computer_use`, `session_search`,
`image_generate`, `todo`, `process`, `cronjob` and `browser_vault`.

listing.description: Whether the `tool_search` description lists the deferred tools.

listing_max_tokens.description:
Token budget (4 characters each) of the deferrable schemas, and of
the deferred-tool manifest in the `tool_search` description.

max_search_limit.description: The most matches per query `tool_search` returns.

mode.description:
`auto` defers MCP and plugin tools behind `tool_search`,
`tool_describe` and `tool_call` when their schemas outgrow the
thresholds below; `on` always does, `off` never.

search_default_limit.description: Matches per query when `tool_search` names no `limit`.

threshold_pct.description:
Percent of the main model's context window the deferrable tools'
schemas may take before `auto` defers them.

oneOf.description: Defer when the deferrable schemas outgrow the thresholds.

default_timeout_secs.description: Timeout of a tool call that declares none.

disabled_toolsets.description: Toolsets removed last, even when a composite lists them.

kill_grace_secs.description: Wait between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when cancelling tool processes.

tool_search.description: Progressive disclosure of large tool surfaces.

surfaces.description:
Starting toolsets per session surface, replacing the surface's
default (spec: tool-system, Per-surface default toolsets).

enabled.description: Record trajectories for sessions started from now on.

max_bytes_per_session.description: Stop recording payload bodies of a session beyond this size.

retention_secs.description: Delete unpinned trajectories older than this; `0` keeps forever.

oneOf.description: Ask on the session's own surface.

auto_resume.description:
`recent`: a TUI launched without `--resume`, `--continue` or a
prompt re-attaches to the session this profile last used in the
TUI from the same working directory.

busy_indicator.description: The glyphs of the busy indicator (`/indicator`).

keys.description:
Key bindings: action name to key chord (`Ctrl+P`, `Alt+Enter`,
`PageUp`, `F2`); `/keys` lists the effective bindings.

reduced_motion.description: No spinners or animation: a static busy glyph.

TuiKeys.description:
`[ui.tui.keys]`: one chord per action; an unset action keeps its
default, an unknown action name is refused.

banner.description: Move to the startup banner's section headers (default `Ctrl+B`).

complete.description: Complete the `/command` or `@path` under the cursor (default `Tab`).

expand_paste.description:
Expand the paste chip before the cursor into its text (default
`Ctrl+O`).

interrupt.description: Stop the running turn, else clear the composer (default `Ctrl+C`).

line_end.description: Move to the end of the line (default `Ctrl+E`).

line_start.description: Move to the start of the line (default `Ctrl+A`).

newline.description:
Insert a line break (default `Alt+Enter`; `Shift+Enter` always
does on terminals that report it).

page_down.description: Scroll the transcript one page down (default `PageDown`).

page_up.description: Scroll the transcript one page up (default `PageUp`).

quit.description: Leave the TUI when the composer is empty (default `Ctrl+D`).

scroll_down.description: Scroll the transcript one line down (default `Ctrl+Down`).

scroll_up.description: Scroll the transcript one line up (default `Ctrl+Up`).

oneOf.description: Picked for the terminal's background (dark when unknown).
Light text on a dark background.
Dark text on a light background.

interface.description:
Interactive interface when stdin and stdout are terminals: the
full-screen `tui` or the `line` CLI (`--tui`/`--line` override it).

status_bar.description:
Show the status bar (`/statusbar`, `/sb`); in the line interface a
single bottom status line on a terminal.

status_bar_battery.description:
Show the battery level as the first status item (`/battery`);
omitted on machines without a battery.

UnattendedApproval.description: Decisions for approvals nobody can answer.

UnauthorizedDm.description: What an unauthorized direct message gets.

oneOf.description: A pairing code the owner can approve.

bitwarden.description: The Bitwarden CLI as a read-only login source.

key_storage.description:
Where a new vault's key is kept: `file` (`<profile>/vault/vault.key`)
or `keychain` (the OS keychain; the file when none is reachable).
`prometheus vault key migrate --to` moves an existing key.

onepassword.description: The 1Password CLI as a read-only login source.

VaultKeyStorage.description: Where the vault key is kept.

enabled.description: Offer its logins when its CLI is installed and signed in.

echo_transcripts.description: Echo a transcript back to the chat once.

stt_enabled.description:
Transcribe inbound voice and audio clips with the profile's
speech-to-text provider.

oneOf.description: When the user's message was voice.

backend.description:
Shared backend for web search and extract (`auto` picks the first
with credentials).

oneOf.description: The value differs from `value` (or is missing).
The string contains `value`, or the list holds it.
The value is a line of `file` (relative to the profile directory).
The string matches the regular expression `pattern`.

WebhookFilters.description: A route's filters: one condition or a list that must all hold.

deliver.description:
Where the answer goes: `origin` (the HTTP caller's response),
`log` (recorded under `<profile>/logs/webhook/<route>.jsonl`),
`github_comment` (a comment on the payload's pull request or issue)
or a send target `platform[:chat_id[:thread_id]]`. Unset: `origin`.

deliver_extra.description: More send targets that receive a copy.

deliver_only.description: Run no model: the rendered prompt is sent verbatim to `deliver`.

events.description:
Event types admitted (`X-GitHub-Event`, `X-GitLab-Event` or the
payload's `event_type`); empty admits every event.

filters.description:
Conditions a payload must meet; a request that fails them is
answered `ignored` with reason `filter`.

github_token_secret.description: The secret holding the GitHub token `github_comment` posts with.

insecure_no_auth.description:
Admit unsigned requests (only while `gateway.http.listen` is a
loopback address).

mirror_to_session.description:
Append the delivered answer to each send target's chat session as
an attributed assistant message.

origin_wait_secs.description:
With `deliver = "origin"`: seconds the HTTP caller is kept waiting
for the answer; a run taking longer is answered 202 `accepted` and
its answer goes to the route's log.

prompt.description:
The turn's input: `{a.b.c}` paths into the payload, `{__raw__}`
the whole payload. Unset: the payload as JSON.

rate_limit_per_min.description:
Requests per minute the route admits (fixed window); more are
answered 429.

script.description:
A transform script under the profile's `scripts/` directory, run in
the sandbox with the payload JSON on stdin.

script_timeout_secs.description: Seconds the transform script may run.

secret_secret.description:
The secret every request must be signed with (GitHub, GitLab,
Standard Webhooks or the generic scheme).

skills.description:
Skills preloaded into each delivery's session (ignored with
`deliver_only`).

toolsets.description:
Toolsets of each delivery's session, replacing the default
read-only `webhook-safe` toolset rather than adding to it; only
toolsets the profile enables.

WireFormat.description:
Natively supported wire formats; any other format needs a provider
plugin.

archive_dirty.description:
Archive dirty or unpushed trees past their idle tier before
removing them; `false` keeps such trees.

archive_max_file_bytes.description:
Untracked files larger than this keep a tree from the sweep
(`keep-large-untracked`) and are left out of archives.

archive_retention_secs.description:
Seconds an archive is kept before the sweep deletes it (`0` =
forever).

max_total_bytes.description:
Total bytes of trees above which the oldest idle ones past their
tier are archived and removed first (`0` = off).

sync_remote.description:
Fetch the default remote before creating a tree (a failed fetch
falls back to the local tip).

agent.description: Turn loop limits, retries and reasoning effort.

approvals.description: Approval modes for dangerous tool calls.

budgets.description: Hard token and cost budgets (`0` = off).

busy.description: What input typed while a turn runs does.

connectors.description: Hosted app connectors (Gmail, Notion...) through the Nous gateway.

cron.description: Profile time zone (scheduler keys arrive with M2).

gateway.description: The profile's part in the home's gateway daemon.

lsp.description: Language server diagnostics after file edits.

models.description:
Model aliases and metadata overrides, keyed by name or
`"<provider>/<model>"`.

plugins.description: Plugin enablement, hook bounds and WASM limits.

providers.description: Per-provider overrides, keyed by provider id.

python_bridge.description: The python bridge: managed interpreter and sidecar bounds.

quick_commands.description: User slash commands (`/<name>`), keyed by name.

schema_version.description:
Version of this file's schema; older files are migrated forward and
a newer one is refused.

terminal.description: The terminal tool and its backends.

tools.description: Toolset selection, timeouts and result budgets.

worktrees.description: Git worktrees: creation, the stale-tree sweep and archives.
